decisions.title: New Mexico Statewide Transportation Improvement Program, FFY 2024-2029 - Approved Snapshot (August 2026)
decisions.description: Preserves the August 2026 approved statewide STIP snapshot with scope, agency, status, locations, maps, and phase-by-phase funding for 1,130 programmed projects, including Albuquerque-area investments and their statewide funding context.
decisions.provenance_status: official public NMDOT STIP Viewer report endpoint and byte-identical downloaded file recorded
processing_notes: Original authoritative 1,132-page PDF preserved without modification.
Exact size and SHA-256 recorded; complete text extraction and representative first, Albuquerque-area interior, and final pages reviewed.
The report contains 1,130 unique projects across 1,131 project-detail pages, plus a generated blank first page.
